name: naphazoline + polysorbate 80
purpose: Purpose Naphazoline hydrochloride - Redness reliever Polysorbate 80 - Lubricant
uses: Uses relieves redness of the eye due to minor eye irritations temporarily relieves burning and irritation due to dryness of the eye for protection against further irritation
otcwarn: Ask a doctor before use if you have narrow angle glaucoma Stop use and ask a doctor if you feel eye pain changes in vision occur redness or irritation of the eyes lasts condition worsens or lasts more than 72 hours
